# This Old House

> > America's trusted home improvement resource featuring expert advice on renovation, repair, safety, and design from the This Old House team including Amy Matthews and the Reviews Team.

This Old House provides comprehensive guides, product reviews, and expert insights for homeowners tackling projects from fire safety to modern design trends. The site features project showcases like the TOH 2021 Modern Barnhouse and partnerships with leading brands in home improvement and building materials.

## Key Topics

- Home Safety and Fire Prevention
- Fire Extinguisher Classes (A, B, C, A:B:C)
- Scandinavian Design
- Modern Barnhouse Projects
- Stone Products and Outdoor Design
- Cultured Stone and Boral Stone Division
- Kindred Outdoors + Surrounds
- Residential Safety Equipment
- Home Renovation and Repair
- Design Trends and Discussions
- Expert Reviews and Product Selection
- Amy Matthews and This Old House Reviews Team

## Home Safety and Protection

- [How To Choose and Use Fire Extinguishers](https://www.thisoldhouse.com/home-safety/best-fire-extinguisher): Guide to selecting and using fire extinguishers for home safety and protection
